source_locator: Page 1, City of Houston, Mayor, Total column (Harris County Cumulative Report, Official)
verification_note: Runoff decided the office after the November 5, 2019 first round (Turner 114,926, Buzbee 69,634 of 245,362 mayoral votes in the city secretary combined general election file). No combined citywide runoff document was available: the city secretary index link for the December 14, 2019 file (121419pdf) and the URLs 121419.pdf under houstontx.gov/citysec/election/ and /elections/ all returned HTTP 404. Houston runoff totals are the sum of three county reports. Harris: Turner 113,262, Buzbee 88,844 (official cumulative). Montgomery: Turner 30, Buzbee 65 (official canvass report, Totals row). Fort Bend: Turner 3,029, Buzbee 252. The Fort Bend figure comes from the Fort Bend County elections office results site (Clarity ENR, election 99826, version 236476, contest 'City of Houston Mayor', json/en/summary.json, opened and read directly; 11 of 11 precincts reporting). The county labels this site unofficial, and no Fort Bend canvass PDF for the December 14 runoff exists on the county 2019 results page (its canvass, cumulative and precinct PDFs are for November 5, 2019). The Fort Bend vote is therefore county-published but not certified in a document we could open. Sums: Turner 116,321, Buzbee 89,161. Fort Bend is 1.4 percent of the Turner total and 0.3 percent of the Buzbee total; the winner and runner-up do not depend on it.
